review_summary: Independent JARVIS review approves V03 Layer 00 as the locked night base. The GitHub Actions artifact was downloaded and candidate.png independently hashed to a6056c69baaab4912169e78e0d7883fa666bc215e3cf3144c3df03efccb80a1a, exactly matching the artifact manifest and published state. Visually, the scene reads as a genuine lights-off base rather than a designed lighting layer: the sweet counters, wall shelves, ceiling grid, circulation, and seating do not show an active proposed electric-lighting family, while only restrained residual environmental illumination remains so the architecture is still readable. There are no visible pendants, tracks, surface fixtures, glowing ceiling apertures, shelf-strip graphics, or artificial hero lighting. The store remains sufficiently dark to give later counter, wall-wash, shelf, circulation, and seating layers meaningful contrast headroom. Source continuity is additionally corroborated by the immutable native source extraction record, exact matching dimensions, zero alignment offset, and high edge-correlation QA, but this approval is based on the independent visual inspection of the actual artifact rather than QA alone.
hard_locks: Candidate a6056c69baaab4912169e78e0d7883fa666bc215e3cf3144c3df03efccb80a1a is the immutable approved V03 Layer 00 parent and must not be regenerated or reinterpreted unless explicitly reopened by JARVIS.
Camera, crop, focal character, perspective, architecture, ceiling grid, counters, shelves, furniture, products, materials, and colours remain locked for all later V03 layers.
Layer 00 remains the all-proposed-electric-lighting-off baseline. No later worker may backfill lighting into this parent.

All added electric lighting from Layer 01 onward must read as 3000K and be recessed, concealed, or integrated only. No pendant, track, surface fixture, raw LED strip line, or LED-dot texture is permitted.

V03 Layer 01 must equal approved Layer 00 plus only the released recessed counter-downlighting family. The sweet counter must become the strongest retail destination without globally lifting exposure.
Residual environmental light visible in Layer 00 may remain only as source-consistent ambient context and must not be amplified to simulate a lighting circuit.
Presentation generation remains locked until every required view has valid independent JARVIS approvals through completion.
